limitations: Offline operational observation only; no external telemetry provider, exporter, or cloud monitoring agent exists.
Alerts are delivered to the Control Center, local logs and audit history only. Email, SMS, push and webhook destinations are rejected with a normalized forbidden_destination error.
Recovery is simulated against local snapshots. Live state is never mutated and nothing is applied to production.
Load validation is a closed-form deterministic model, not generated traffic. No threads are spawned, no sockets opened, no sleeps taken.
The operations dashboard is read-only. It exposes no execution, deployment, connectivity, credential, or order control.
Health state, metric thresholds, alerts and diagnostics are advisory. None of them remediate, escalate, unlock, or grant authority.
Browser certification history is read, never written.
No provider connectivity, credential, OAuth, account, balance, position, order, canary, deployment or live-trading path exists or is created by this milestone.
known_pre_existing_conditions: tests/test_m157_private_alpha.py, tests/test_m57_local.py and tests/test_ops.py::test_release_gate_passes_baseline fail on this machine. All were reproduced on a clean clone at the base SHA and predate this branch.

The SaathiOS app shell polls /api/v1/connectors/approvals/pending, which answers 401 without CORS headers on the local browser-certification harness. Those request failures and console messages originate outside M328-M335 and are attributed separately in the browser certification record.
